ValidationRule.description: For System Admin Cases with Status = Open, Expected Completion Date cannot be less than 10 Days from Creation Date
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( RecordType.Id = '01290000001IINP', /*System Admin Cases*/ NOT ( $Profile.Id = '00e90000001wK8z'), /*System Admin Profile*/ Expected_Completion_Date__c - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) < 10, ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Open') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Expected Completion Date cannot be less than 10 Days from Today.
